title: How to Correct an AI Overview: The Report Button Is Not the Fix
meta_description: You cannot edit an AI Overview or a ChatGPT answer. In two cases decided in 2026, reports did not stop the false answers. What to fix, and what to keep on file.
secondary_keywords: how to report incorrect ai overview
how to correct ai information on google
chatgpt wrong information about my business

image.takeaway: Keene reported the AI Overviews to Google three times. A judge let his claim proceed 475 days after the first.
image.alt: How to correct an AI Overview: Google takes reports through a thumbs down button, and in Keene v. Google the dated complaints became part of the court record
